item.title: Classic Tracks: The O'-Jay's "For the Love of Money"
item.description: By Blair Jackson. "For the Love of Money" had interesting audio trickery in it, most famously the ghostly refrain of "Money, money, money" blowing through the song like an ill wind.

item.title: Classic Tracks: Genesis' "The Lamb Lies Down on Broadway"
item.description: By Tim Morse. It's not surprising that decades down the line many people don't realize that Peter Gabriel was once a driving member of Genesis—an effort that arguably met its apex with The Lamb Lies Down on Broadway.

item.title: Classic Track: Rick Springfield, "Jessie's Girl"
item.description: By Barbara Schultz. Rick Springfield's "Jessie's Girl" sports a killer hook, taut storytelling and producer Keith Olsen's clean production.

item.title: Classic Track: The Chambers Brothers, “Time Has Come Today”
item.description: By Blair Jackson. Not too many people these days know about the Chamber Brothers, but when their first Columbia album, The Time Has Come, was released in late 1967, it was a very big deal.

item.title: Classic Tracks: Dire Straits' "Money for Nothing"
item.description: By Blair Jackson. A stinging critique of the 1980s even as they happened, Dire Straits' "Money For Nothing" had a lengthy genesis, as related here by engineer Neil Dorfsman.

item.title: Funktion-One Debuts PSM15 Stage Monitor - Mixonline
item.description: Funktion-One has a new stage monitor out—the PSM15, a triaxial, bi-amped design using a 15-inch low frequency driver.

item.title: Audiomovers Announces Unsung Season 2 - Mixonline
item.description: Remote audio tool developer Audiomovers has announced a March 26 debut for season 2 of its Unsung podcast series.

item.title: NAMM Show 2026 Product Wrap-Up, Part 1 - Mixonline
item.description: The 2026 NAMM Show in late January was loaded with new product introductions. Here, in alphabetical order, are a few that caught the eyes and ears of Mix editors.

item.title: AMPS Announces Sound Awards Nominations - Mixonline
item.description: The Association of Motion Picture Sound (AMPS) has announced the nominees for its annual Excellence in Sound Awards.

item.title: Royer Labs Acquired - Mixonline
item.description: Emerging private equity firm Sounds Great Holdings has taken the reigns to guide ribbon microphone mainstay Royer Labs.
